notes: Structure as living-room.json. category = Bible controlled vocabulary (textile, lighting, ceramics-tableware, storage-function, art-decor-toys); fixed-product furniture is storage-function. placement uses the product-card enum; placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. Tie-break: product layers that share a z never overlap by design (if they do, the one nearer the camera goes on top); shadow layers are multiply and order-independent; no product shares its z with a shadow layer. plan_m in house coordinates, Z from the floor. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design; seen_in = transit only. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render. fillers = unsold contents (Bible 1.5).

MB0.hero: the bed wall as a sanctuary: bed centre u 0.50, sconces u 0.269 / 0.731, art centred; window on the left wall u 0-0.138 (46% cut); bed foot as the cut foreground

density.rule: Bible 1.7.1 S11: full-route frame, minimum 14 is a floor; as many as the designer judges do not detract. Counted (rule D1, 2026-10-10, with user decision D1B, 2026-10-11) = a slot whose product is >= 50% visible and covers >= 0.5% of the frame; a set counts once; fixed-product furniture counts under the same rule (D1B: here bed and nightstands); not counted: neighbouring-room products, fillers, shell, fixed furniture that is not sold. A frame still short gets sold products from docs/proposals/density-after-d1.md (D1B). The counts below were estimated under the rejected 1.6 wording; the D1 counts in that proposal were measured without fixed-product: to re-measure with fixed-product counted (next clay).

by_style.rule: by_style.<style>.slots.<slot> overrides only the fields it lists; everything else comes from the slot's base entry below. A slot whose base entry has "styles" exists only in those styles. 'frames' here are that style's frames; frames [] = no frame in that style (catalog only). Positions are the rendered, QA-passed ones (house plan 1.3.9, AP3-KW); 'rendered_default' is the product id of the default layer in the frame's layers/manifest.json, for tracing only (the selection is not set here).
